description: Commercial accounts in a mixture of Judaeo-Arabic and Arabic script (also Greek/Coptic numerals). Mentions a debt owed by Ibn ʿAbd al-Ẓāhir (also the name of a well known chancery scribe in the 13th century, conceivably the person intended here). On verso mentions a qāḍī.
description_he: חשבונות מסחריים בתערובת של יהודית-ערבית וכתב ערבי (וכן ספרות יווניות/קופטיות).
